title: IN WHICH A CONVERSATION TAKES PLACE WHICH SEEMS LIKELY TO COST PHILEAS FOGG DEAR
summary_hover: At the Reform Club, Phileas Fogg wagers twenty thousand pounds that he can travel around the world in eighty days, departing that very evening.
summary_detail: Phileas Fogg arrives at the Reform Club and joins his usual whist partners. The men discuss a recent theft of fifty-five thousand pounds from the Bank of England and the likelihood of the culprit's escape. Fogg argues that the world has grown smaller and wagers twenty thousand pounds that he can circumnavigate the globe in eighty days. Despite his friends' doubts, Fogg pledges to depart for Dover that same evening and return by December 21st.
